author: NorthEast News Desk
body: An off-duty Sandwich police officer was arrested after a suspected impaired-driving crash in the Forestdale section of town Friday night, according to the department. Police identified the officer as Matthew Cotter, 44, and said no injuries were reported.

Authorities said an SUV traveled through bushes and hit a parked vehicle on Grand Oak Road at about 9:30 p.m. Responding Sandwich officers believed the driver showed signs of impairment and called Massachusetts State Police to handle the investigation because the suspect was a member of the local department. State police then arrested Cotter on OUI-related charges.

Sandwich police placed Cotter on administrative leave and opened an internal investigation. He is expected to be arraigned in Barnstable District Court; information about an attorney was not immediately available. Police also said a separate investigation was opened after a relative at the scene allegedly became verbally abusive and assaultive toward a news photographer. The allegations in both matters remain subject to investigation and court review.
dek: State police arrested Matthew Cotter after an SUV went through bushes and struck a parked vehicle in Forestdale, local police said.
headline: Off-duty Sandwich officer arrested after suspected OUI crash
